name: Detect Magic
summary: Sense magic within 30 feet; use a Magic action to see auras on magical things and learn spell schools.
text: For the duration you sense whether any magical effects are present within 30 feet of you. If you sense some, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around every visible creature or object in that area that carries magic, and for an effect created by a spell you learn that spell's school of magic. The sense is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt or wood, 1 inch of metal, or a thin sheet of lead. Concentration, up to 10 minutes. Can be cast as a Ritual.
